name: threadforge-root
description: ThreadForge: Interactive Multithreading Performance and Race Condition Laboratory

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "green,yellow" "cmd /c .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload" "cmd /c cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cmd /c cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.test: concurrently -n "pytest,vitest" "cmd /c .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest backend/tests/ -v" "cmd /c cd frontend && npm test"
